text_block_list.text:
My mother has been a famous stage
actor for as
long as I can remember.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
"So long as you do not discard your

qualifications, you shall always possess
them."
text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother

text_block_list.text:
"Even if you find yourself without a
sword, or
incapable of swiftly attaining
your dreams, you
still have a path of
your own."
text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Her audience of thousands hung onto
her every
word.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Her every breath and movement was like
that of a
dream to them.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: One day, I'm gonna be just like her...
text_block_list.name: Young Fuji

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
Hyaaah!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Today marks Фудзи Кисэки and I's entry into
the
Twinkle Series. It is a day worthy of

commemoration.

Hahahaha! Not half bad, Fuji! But go
faster!
Faster, I say!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки has been embroiled in some

experiment by Агнес Тахион—a rather
odd
runner with a penchant for research.
Huff! Puff!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Sigh! Fuji looked so cool sprinting toward the finish after getting pushed to her limits like that!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text:
And she hasn't even debuted yet! If this
is her
now, she's going to be even more
incredible
going forward!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan B

text_block_list.text:
There's quite a crowd gathered. Seems a
lot of
people have high hopes for you,
Fuji.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's true. I happen to be blessed
with the
love of many. My fans give me
the strength to
keep me going!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Whenever I feel their expectant eyes on
me, I
can't help but want to give them a
good show.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well, setting aside your
personality quirks
for a moment...
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
I collected some good data! I needed
pre-debut
runners who are able to reach
a certain speed!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad there are so many guinea
pi—runners
here! I'll be reaching out to
you again in the
future!
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text: Sure, anytime!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ah, by the way. I heard you're taking on
the
Twinkle Series today.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Getting lost in thought в середине забега is a
dangerous
practice. Take care not to get
hurt.
text_block_list.name: Агнес Тахион

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You noticed that, huh? I guess
I've still
got a long ways to go.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
(When I think about what I'm starting
today, I
can't help but recall the past...)
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Young Fuji

text_block_list.text:
Wasn't Фудзи Кисэки great? She really gave
it her all!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Right? She's so charming, you can't help
but root
for her. I can't wait to see her
next show!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: ...Was that my all?
text_block_list.name: Young Fuji

text_block_list.text:
Mother, do you think I'll be able to
become as
good of an entertainer as you
one day?
text_block_list.name: Young Fuji

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll ever be able to get lots
and lots of
applause like you do...
text_block_list.name: Young Fuji

text_block_list.text:
Listen, Fuji. You can't keep chasing me
forever.
text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother

text_block_list.text:
There's more than one path in life. You
have to
broaden your view.
text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Set your eyes on a destination that you
and only
you can reach.
text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother

text_block_list.text: A destination that only I can reach...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Could I finally be taking the first steps
on that
journey?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Fujiii!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans

text_block_list.text:
Your speed trial with Tachyon was
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how you'll do in the
Twinkle
Series!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'll do my best to meet your

expectations!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Training that day ends on a particularly
high note.
Hey there, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to say to you,
today
being such an important day to us
and all.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Is now a good time?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Right now, we're embarking on a journey
most
dazzling.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My goal, of course, is to become the
best
entertainer in the world...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
And to that end, there is a peak I simply
must
reach in my classic year!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I want to claim the Classic Triple Crown!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is a title only
bestowed
upon those who win the
Satsuki Sho, the
Japanese Derby, and
the Kikuka Sho.

Few racers have managed to claim such
a title,
though many yearn for the honor
of bearing it.

I'm lucky enough to have a lot of ponies
who
believe in me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I want to make them all proud by
reaching that
summit and gifting them
with a catharsis most
wonderful!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
If she wants to become the world's best

entertainer, then there is no greater
stage for a
classic-year racer.

As a trainer, it's my job to match my
trainee's
enthusiasm and passion.
Hehe! Thank you! I knew you'd say that.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Good, now we've settled on our first
goal.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Wait, there are even more goals?!

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Getting the Triple Crown is
no more
than the beginning.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My story can't end so quickly. I'm trying
to
overtake an entertainer of legendary
status.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The road will be immeasurably long and
full of
thorns. There's even a possibility
I'll fail to reach
my goal.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But as Hamlet said, "If it be not now, yet
it will
come—the readiness is all."
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Shirking this challenge isn't an option!
That's why
I want to prepare for it
together.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: She kneels and takes out a single flower.

Trainer, will you walk this thorny path
alongside
me?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Her eyes sparkle brightly under the glow
of the
milky moon. I pluck the flower
from her hand in a
mesmerized haze.
Thank you. I'm glad to have you with me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The head of the flower she gave me
droops
elegantly. Its petals are a
gorgeous purple.

And so, my days running through the
Twinkle
Series with Фудзи Кисэки begin.
